name: Pritilata Waddedar
seoTitle: Pritilata Waddedar: Chittagong Revolutionary and Anti-Colonial Martyr
seoDescription: Profile of Pritilata Waddedar, the Bengali revolutionary linked to the Chittagong armed movement and the 1932 Pahartali European Club attack.
shortAnswer: Pritilata Waddedar was a Bengali revolutionary and teacher who joined the Chittagong armed movement and died after the 1932 Pahartali European Club attack.
role: Revolutionary of the Chittagong armed movement
contribution: She took part in revolutionary operations in Chittagong and led the 1932 Pahartali European Club attack team.
context: She entered militant anti-colonial politics in a period when women’s direct participation in armed struggle was rare.
impact: Her martyrdom became an enduring reference point for women’s courage in anti-colonial resistance.
highlight: A defining woman revolutionary in Bengal’s anti-colonial struggle.

faq.question: Why is Pritilata Waddedar important after 1900?
faq.answer: She represents the participation of women in militant anti-colonial politics in Bengal and is remembered for her role in the Chittagong revolutionary network.

faq.question: Which timeline event is she most closely linked to?
faq.answer: She is linked to the Chittagong Armoury Raid movement and the wider revolutionary network around Surya Sen in the early 1930s.
